description: This file provides utility functions for locating, executing, and parsing information about Google Chrome browser executables across different platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows). It includes functions to find Chrome based on platform-specific paths, execute commands to get version info, and parse major version numbers.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: execText
methods.description: Executes a command with arguments and returns the output as a trimmed string, or null on failure.

methods.name: findFirstChromeExecutable
methods.description: Iterates over candidate paths to find the first existing Chrome executable and determines its kind (chrome or canary).

methods.name: findGoogleChromeExecutableMac
methods.description: Finds Chrome executable paths on macOS.

methods.name: findGoogleChromeExecutableLinux
methods.description: Finds Chrome executable paths on Linux.

methods.name: findGoogleChromeExecutableWindows
methods.description: Finds Chrome executable paths on Windows.
